caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular mirror with a decorative frame. The frame, shown in grayscale, is composed of alternating twisted rope-like segments and large, shell-like fan shapes at the four corners. The center of the drawing shows the reflective surface of the mirror, which also has a narrow inner border with shaded corners. The overall composition is symmetrical, with the decorative motifs equally spaced around the frame. In the lower left area of the page, there is a horizontal scale marked in inches, and in the lower right corner, the name "George Stevenson" is written in script. The background is plain and light-colored, with a few small scattered brown spots.
title: Mirror
